# Banishwor Athokpam (Bani // BANI OS)

> Banishwor Athokpam (also known as **Banishwor**, and informally known as **Bani** or **Bani Athokpam**; published author as *Banishwor Athokpam*, blogger at *baniat.blogspot.com* under the pseudonym *bani*, and digital media creator of *Bani Entertainment* / *HaloBan Media*) is a software developer, computer science educator, and published author from Thoubal, Manipur, India.

Banishwor specializes in native Android engineering (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, offline-first architectures), modern full-stack web applications (React, TypeScript, GSAP, Web Audio API), distributed systems, and digital cultural informatics preserving the indigenous Meitei Mayek script and Kangleipak heritage.

- **Primary Portfolio & Apps Hub**: https://banishwor.github.io/
- **Interactive Spatial Operating System (BANI // OS)**: https://banishwor.github.io/aboutme/
- **Comprehensive LLM Technical Specification**: https://banishwor.github.io/aboutme/llms-full.txt
- **Official Résumé**: https://banishwor.github.io/aboutme/resume.pdf

## Active Production Applications

### 1. Manipur Calculator
- **Category**: Native Android Utility
- **Tech Stack**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB, BigDecimal Arithmetic
- **Status**: Production Active
- **Capabilities & Highlights**:
  - Combines modern financial calculators (Loan EMI, Simple/Compound Interest) with traditional Manipuri land unit converters (**Pari, Lourak, Sangam, Loushal**) and Indian gold weight converters (**Tola, San, Chaning, Rati, Ana**).
  - Built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, arbitrary-precision `BigDecimal` arithmetic, and a 100% offline Room database.
  - Eliminates calculation disputes in rural land valuations and gold transactions with sub-decimal precision.
  - Fully bilingual with English and Meitei Mayek representations.

### 2. Yek Salai
- **Category**: Native Android & Cross-Platform Cultural Application
- **Tech Stack**: React Native, Firebase Remote Config, Structured Cultural Schemas
- **Status**: Production Active
- **Capabilities & Highlights**:
  - Comprehensive cultural preservation mobile app for the Meitei community in Manipur.
  - Provides an exhaustive database of 860+ surnames mapped across the 7 sacred clans (*Salais* / *Yek-Salai*).
  - Instant marriage compatibility verification based on sacred customary laws (*Yek Tinnaba*, *Shairuk Tinnaba*).

### 3. Manipuri Calendar
- **Category**: Native Android Utility & PWA
- **Tech Stack**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android Glance Widgets, Vanilla JS Astro Engine
- **Status**: Production Active (Android & PWA)
- **Capabilities & Highlights**:
  - Dual-calendar system featuring the traditional Meitei lunar calendar (with Meitei Mayek script) alongside Gregorian dates.
  - Tracks 200+ Manipuri festivals, moon phases, *Tatnaba* calculations, daily horoscopes, and customizable Android home screen widgets (2×2, 4×1, 4×2).
  - 100% free, privacy-focused, and completely ad-free.
  - **PWA Link**: https://banishwor.github.io/manipuri-calendar-pwa/
  - **Google Play**: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.manipurcalendar

### 4. Khutsuman (ꯈꯨꯠꯁꯨꯃꯟ)
- **Category**: Native Android Utility
- **Tech Stack**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room DB (Encrypted SQLCipher), Material 3
- **Status**: Production Active / Beta
- **Capabilities & Highlights**:
  - Daily wage, attendance, and Hisab ledger manager engineered specifically for construction site supervisors, petty contractors (*Mohoriks*), master carpenters, and labor teams in Manipur and across India.
  - 100% offline functionality with an encrypted local Room database, ensuring sensitive wage data and contracts remain safe even in remote hill sites without mobile connectivity.
  - Supports granular attendance (Full Day 1.0, Half Day 0.5, Overtime hours, Absentee marks), multi-site job organization, instant wage balance calculation, client advance tracking, and WhatsApp-ready vector PDF report exports.

## R&D, Experimental & Archived Projects

### 1. LeikaiFix
- **Category**: Civic Tech Infrastructure Prototype (Web & Android)
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Geolocation API
- **Status**: Prototype / Paused (due to legal and municipal regulatory considerations)
- **Overview**: Civic grievance reporting prototype enabling citizens to report local breakdowns (potholes, water pipeline leaks, damaged transformers) with automated GPS spatial mapping to concerned local authorities.

### 2. On-Device AI Keyboard (FlorisBoard Meitei Mayek)
- **Category**: Android Input Method Engine (IME)
- **Tech Stack**: Open-Source Keyboard Layout Architecture, Unicode 5.2 Meitei Mayek
- **Status**: Open-Source Layout / Archived R&D
- **Overview**: Privacy-preserving Android software keyboard customized from open-source FlorisBoard, supporting the complete 35-character Meitei Mayek script, Cheikhei, and diacritics. Explored on-device lightweight language models for local text prediction.

### 3. Viral Prompts
- **Category**: AI Prompt Engineering Utility
- **Tech Stack**: TypeScript, Modern Web UI
- **Status**: Archived
- **Overview**: Creative prompt curation tool for AI art and text generators (Midjourney, DALL-E, Gemini, ChatGPT) with categorized templates and variable parameter substitution.
